drug.name: セマグルチド経口
drug.category: GLP-1 受容体作動薬 (経口製剤)

high_risk_surgery_examples: 全身麻酔を伴う手術全般
low_risk_surgery_examples: 小手術 (絶食を伴うもの)
surgery.note: 経口 1 日 1 回製剤 (リベルサス)。 ASA/AGA/ASMBS/ISPCOP/SAGES 2024 では daily formulation に分類され、高リスク時は手術当日休薬。添付文書には休薬日数の記載はない。週 1 回皮下注製剤 (セマグルチド注射) とは投与間隔が異なるため休薬期間も異なる。消化器症状がある場合は待機手術延期を考慮。

surgery.source_title: Multi-society clinical practice guidance for the safe use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in the perioperative period (ASA/AGA/ASMBS/ISPCOP/SAGES)
surgery.quote_excerpt: "holding the day of surgery for daily formulations"

references.title: ASA Consensus-based Guidance on Preoperative Management of Patients on GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
references.quote_excerpt: "For patients on daily dosing consider holding GLP-1 agonists on the day of the procedure/surgery. This suggestion is irrespective of the indication (type 2 diabetes mellitus or weight loss), dose, or the type of procedure/surgery." / "If gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms such as severe nausea/vomiting/retching, abdominal bloating, or abdominal pain are present, consider delaying elective procedure, and discuss the concerns of potential risk of regurgitation and pulmonary aspiration of gastric contents with the proceduralist/surgeon and the patient."
references.location_in_source: "For patients scheduled for elective procedures" 推奨 1 (daily dosing)

セマグルチド経口 医療用医薬品 検索結果 (KEGG MEDICUS)

references.source: AGA / ASMBS / ASA / ISPCOP / SAGES (米国 5 学会共同)
references.title: Multi-society clinical practice guidance for the safe use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in the perioperative period
references.quote_excerpt: GLP-1RA therapy may be continued pre-operatively in patients without elevated-risk of delayed gastric emptying and aspiration based on Recommendation 1a. … If the decision to hold GLP-1RAs is indicated given an unacceptable safety profile following shared-decision making in the pre-operative period, the duration to hold therapy is unknown. At this time, it is suggested to follow the original guidance of the American Society of Anesthesiologists, holding the day of surgery for daily formulations, and a week prior to surgery for weekly formulations.
references.location_in_source: p.2 Section 'Recommendations' Rec 1a (risk factors) + Rec 1b (continue if no risk) + Rec 1c (hold duration: daily=day-of, weekly=1w prior)
